notes: Projectile speed: AE lets a player reach 166% movement (playerRunSpeedCapMax in records\game\gameengine.dbr) while projectile velocities stayed at their 2006 values, so every cast trails the pace of the fight. multiply_player_projectiles 1.66 restores that ratio.

Cast speed: TQ has no per-skill cast speed — no player skill carries a cast-timing variable, and characterSpellCastSpeedModifier appears only on buff/passive records as a character stat grant. So the knob is the character, set once on the two Player records beside characterRunSpeed (a mastery-based grant would stack on a dual-mastery character). 66% matches the projectile compensation and reads roughly as a Battle Shrine buff permanently on. Player cap is playerSpellCastSpeedCapMax = 300; verify on the character sheet, which shows Casting Speed as a percent. How much this is a DPS buff rather than pure responsiveness depends entirely on the mastery: every Earth skill the player casts is cooldown-gated (Volcanic Orb 5s, Flame Surge 6s, Rain of Fire 18s, Eruption 20s, Ring of Flame 90s/4s), so there it buys less time rooted in the cast and almost no throughput. Storm (Ice Shard, Static Nova, Freezing Blast) and Spirit (Ternion) have 0-cooldown attack skills, and there it is a real power multiplier.

skillProjectileSpeedModifier on the casting skill was tried first and measured inert in game — Volcanic Orb still took its vanilla 3.0s at 150. It is a character stat granted by passives and gear (Marksmanship, quivers), not a per-skill override. Only projectileVelocity moves flight time.

Volcanic Orb is the outlier: velocity 11 over range 33 is a 3.00s flight, the slowest of any player skill against a 1.3-1.6s norm. Tuned by feel against the user's own casts — 28 (1.18s) read as 'noticeably faster but still slow', so it sits at 55 for a 0.60s flight at full range. Flight time at full range is 33/velocity; the engine ships ProjectileExploding records up to 100, so there is headroom either way. VolcanicOrbLobbed01 is also fired by Colossal Fire Elemental's meteor, which speeds up with it.
